caseNameFull: Berger, Receiver v. Chase National Bank Schram, Receiver v. Same Wardell, Receiver v. Same Young, Successor to Hardee, Receiver v. Same and Feucht, Liquidating Trustees v. Same
attorneys: Messrs. John Vance Hewitt, Swagar Sherley, Charles F. Wilson, Brice Clagett, George B. Springston, Martin Conboy,' and George P. Barse for petitioners., Mr. Henry Root Stern for respondent.

opinions.text:
The petition for writs of certiorari is granted, and the judgments of the Circuit Court of Appeals are affirmed. Woodring v. Wardell, ante, p. 527; Inland Waterways Corp. v. Young, ante, p. 517.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice McReynolds, and Mr. Justice Roberts dissent. Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of this cause.
